events.title: Fool's Trigger at Next Fest
events.summary: Hey everyone! In the demo you can play multiplayer with three players. The full release will support up to six players, so don't worry! Sorry, not everything is available yet. We had to save something for the full game, after all. And yes, the demo will only be available during Next Fest. That's just how it is. Good luck!

events.title: Playtest is live!
events.summary: April Fools’ !But this is not a joke — you really can try the multiplayer from April 1 to April 7.Access opens at 12:00 GMT 0. Bring your friends and tell us what you think.A big request: after that, please leave feedback in the Google Form —Here. Or in any other way.

events.title: Where We're At with Development
events.summary: Hi there!The work hasn't stopped. Over the past month, we've done a lot, though a surprising amount of time and energy went into the Steam page itself. (Making the trailer, gifs, and decent-looking screenshots is way harder than it sounds.) The big thing — lighting. I got feedback on the screenshots and trailer — many people didn’t like the lighting, so I redid it. You can already see the updated version in the re-recorded trailer.
